stem: The number, $X$, of used computers donated to a charity has a constant average rate of 2.4 computers per week.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State a necessary condition for $X$ to have a Poisson distribution.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Now assume that $X$ has a Poisson distribution.
parts.text: Calculate the probability that the number of computers donated during a 4-week period is more than 6 and less than 9.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to calculate the probability that more than 50 computers are donated during a 20-week period.
